requirements.title: SUM DIM rank-one equivalence and exact integer slice mapping
requirements.definition: For rank-one ARRAY, the DIM form has the value of the no-DIM SUM; for higher rank, each result element is the SUM of the corresponding slice, with the corresponding MASK slice.

pending.SUM-DIM-rank-one-equivalence: Use rank-one default-integer ARRAY [4, -7, 2] with DIM=1 and without DIM; initialize separate sentinels and assert both exact results are -1, then mutate the no-DIM comparison to PRODUCT.
pending.SUM-DIM-integer-slice-mapping: Use A=RESHAPE([1, -2, 3, 5, -7, 4], [2,3]); Fortran column-major order gives columns [1,-2], [3,5], [-7,4], so assert SUM(A,DIM=1)==[-1,8,-3] and row slices [1,3,-7], [-2,5,4] give SUM(A,DIM=2)==[-3,7]; all column and row sums are distinct, and mutating DIM or row/column mapping changes the observed values.
pending.SUM-DIM-integer-mask-slice-mapping: With the same A and MASK=RESHAPE([.true., .false., .true., .true., .false., .true.], [2,3]), column-major mask columns are [T,F], [T,T], [F,T]; assert SUM(A,DIM=1,MASK=MASK)==[1,8,4] and row-mask slices give SUM(A,DIM=2,MASK=MASK)==[4,9]; omitting MASK gives [-1,8,-3] and [-3,7].
